cohort: 700 mothers of healthy, full-term infants in Shiraz, Iran
finding: Older age, giving birth at a private hospital, higher education level, and being overweight or obese were associated with increased likelihood of both elective and emergency cesarean section compared to vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Older age, giving birth at a private hospital, higher education level, and being overweight or obese were associated with increased likelihood of both elective and emergency cesarean section compared to vaginal delivery.
